spec.rule: Qualify only ready standalone historical-level-rejection and multiscale-candle-rejection routes at 30s. Agreement variant requires the original v1 expiry direction ready and aligned and any ready selected projection aligned. Sequence-only variant does not admit those standalone micro-reactions; it preserves existing separately recognized structural sequence changes and retests. Other routes, training, quote inputs, immutable held windows and expiry remain unchanged. No fixed delay or new history.
spec.holdout: 04/06/07/22 UTC windows registered before this candidate or baseline outcomes were evaluated. Same external day as known data; not independent days.
caveats: External Forex data is not user broker OTC, actual orders, current-account accuracy or a profitability test.
Development and known-video data are already inspected; video extractions describe one source and must not be summed.
Filtering alters entry times; compare full actual runtime replays, not removed-entry subgroup rates.

limitations: External Dukascopy Forex data, not IQ Option/Exnova OTC and not the user session.
1m OHLC aggregated from the source ticks, not broker-supplied native candles.
No interpolation or invented ticks; evaluate on actual quoted prices and timestamps.
